english.title: Distributor fail to identify economic operator who supplied / to whom he supplied a pyrotechnic (not F1/F2/F3 firework)

english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 37, 62(3)(m) and 63(2) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.

english.notes:
(i) Where this offence is committed in respect of a pyrotechnic article to which regulation 63(1) applies (i.e. a category F1, F2 or F3 firework), it is summary only - see offence document H12387 (CJS code PA15130)
(ii) The relevant period is -
(a) where an economic operator has supplied a pyrotechnic article, a period of 10 years beginning on the day on which the pyrotechnic article was supplied;
(b) where the manufacturer has supplied an economic operator with a pyrotechnic article, a period of 10 years beginning on the day on which he supplied the pyrotechnic article.
